warningContent.para: WARNING: Display systems contain high voltage circuits. Always disconnect aircraft power before servicing display units.
Electric shock hazard exists even after power disconnect. Wait minimum 5 minutes after power removal for capacitor discharge before handling internal components.
Electronic components in indicating and recording systems are extremely sensitive to electrostatic discharge (ESD).
Always use proper ESD protection (wrist straps, conductive mats, grounded tools) when handling avionics LRUs. Failure to observe ESD precautions may result in latent component damage.
Do not connect or disconnect ARINC 429 or ARINC 664 (AFDX) data buses while power is applied to the system.
Hot-plugging data bus connections may cause bus voltage transients, resulting in corruption of flight-critical data or damage to connected avionics equipment.
Ensure all lightning protection bonds and grounding straps are properly installed and torqued.
Improper bonding may result in lightning-induced overvoltage damage to sensitive avionics equipment during electrical storms.
Recording system battery backup units contain lithium-ion cells. Handle with care. Do not puncture, crush, or expose to temperatures above 60°C (140°F).
Damaged lithium-ion batteries may catch fire or explode. Follow proper hazmat disposal procedures for damaged battery units.
